verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically, plus a headless GraphQL Storefront API. That covers the major admin domains through the API, but nothing in the pack claims or demonstrates parity with everything the control panel can do. API credentials themselves are created in the control panel UI. Missing for 10: an explicit claim or evidence of complete UI-to-API parity, coverage of the full admin surface beyond core domains, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
